description: Na₃MgSbS₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.08 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.68-3.21 Å. Mg is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Mg-S bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three S atoms. There is one shorter (2.47 Å) and two longer (2.53 Å) Sb-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mg atom.
